verdict.rationale: ADK docs explicitly describe deploying agents to a fully managed, auto-scaling Agent Engine/Agent Runtime on Google Cloud, plus alternative managed options like Cloud Run and GKE, with the stated purpose being to make the agent 'accessed, queried, and used in production' as an API endpoint.
